verse.verse_1: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-
verse.verse_2: And removed from thee thy burden
verse.verse_3: The which did gall thy back?-
verse.verse_4: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?
verse.verse_5: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:
verse.verse_6: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
verse.verse_7: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,
verse.verse_8: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.
